subject.title: fix(infra): make exec-approvals lock ownership filesystem-safe

question: Should this rebased PR become the canonical fix candidate instead of the still-open https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028, after exact-head VirtioFS proof is supplied?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same authorization-lock failure with materially overlapping nonce and async-lock designs, while the supplied review context does not establish which branch contains the maintainers’ preferred final lifecycle contract.

options.title: Adopt this rebased PR after proof
options.body: Treat this branch as canonical only after its latest head shows a redacted VirtioFS run that releases its own sidecar and continues to fail closed for genuine contention.

options.title: Continue with the earlier candidate
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028 as the canonical path if its implementation and existing live evidence are preferred, then close this branch as superseded after comparison.

recommendation.title: Adopt this rebased PR after proof
recommendation.body: Treat this branch as canonical only after its latest head shows a redacted VirtioFS run that releases its own sidecar and continues to fail closed for genuine contention.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the detailed production reproduction and own the other open implementation candidate, so they are best placed to clarify the behavioral differences for a maintainer decision.
